source: Wahapedia Aeldari page (Factions.csv AE, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/aeldari) with its craftworld and Ynnari subfactions (parent_id AE), all but Harlequins (CWHA), which has its own catalogue. Wahapedia files Codex: Aeldari's craftworld and Harlequins stratagems with no subfaction id, so both Aeldari catalogues list them.
Wahapedia Drukhari page (Factions.csv DRU, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/drukhari); 'all' for its Kabal, Wych Cult and Haemonculus Coven subfactions (parent_id DRU).

Wahapedia Aeldari page (Factions.csv AE, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/aeldari), Harlequins subfaction (CWHA, parent_id AE). Codex: Aeldari's Harlequins stratagems carry no subfaction id on Wahapedia (type 'Aeldari (Harlequins) – …').
Wahapedia Chaos Knights page (Factions.csv QT, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/chaos-knights); 'all' for its households and Dreadblades (parent_id QT).
Wahapedia Chaos Space Marines page (Factions.csv CSM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/chaos-space-marines); 'all' for its legions (LGxx, parent_id CSM).
Wahapedia Heretic Titan Legions page (Factions.csv HTL, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/heretic-titan-legions); Stratagems.csv has no HTL stratagems.
Wahapedia Chaos Daemons page (Factions.csv CD, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/chaos-daemons); 'all' for its four god subfactions (ALxx, parent_id CD).

Wahapedia Death Guard page (Factions.csv DG, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/death-guard); 'all' for its Plague Companies (PCxx, parent_id DG). Wahapedia also files the Gellerpox Infected stratagems under DG; BSData's Death Guard catalogue imports Chaos - Gellerpox Infected.
Wahapedia Renegades and Heretics page (Factions.csv RaH, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/renegades-and-heretics); Stratagems.csv has no RaH stratagems.

No Wahapedia faction of its own. Its Obsidius Mallex and Black Legionnaires are HERETIC ASTARTES and BLACK LEGION (BSData Chaos - Servants of the Abyss.cat), so the Wahapedia Chaos Space Marines page (CSM) with the Black Legion subfaction (LGBL, parent_id CSM).
Wahapedia Thousand Sons page (Factions.csv TS, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/thousand-sons); 'all' for its Great Cults (GTxx, parent_id TS).
Wahapedia World Eaters page (Factions.csv WE, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/world-eaters); 'all' for its subfactions (WEWW, WERA, parent_id WE).

Wahapedia Chaos Space Marines page (Factions.csv CSM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/chaos-space-marines), where the Fallen Angels stratagems (Index Hereticus: The Fallen) sit with no subfaction id. No legion subfactions: Fallen units have no <LEGION> keyword (BSData Fallen.cat: Chaos, Fallen, Imperium).
Wahapedia Adepta Sororitas page (Factions.csv AS, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/adepta-sororitas); 'all' for its Orders (ORxx, parent_id AS).

Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Black Templars subfaction (CHBT, parent_id SM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/space-marines/black-templars). BSData Imperium - Black Templars.cat offers no successor chapters.

Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Blood Angels subfaction (CHBA, parent_id SM) and its successors as BSData Imperium - Blood Angels.cat offers them: Flesh Tearers (CHFT, 'Successor Chapters') and Lamenters (CHLA, a Forge World chapter shown only for Blood Angels).
Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Dark Angels subfaction (CHDA, parent_id SM). BSData Imperium - Dark Angels.cat names no successor chapter that Wahapedia lists.
Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Deathwatch subfaction (CHDW, parent_id SM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/space-marines/deathwatch).

Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Imperial Fists subfaction (CHIF, parent_id SM) and its successors as BSData Imperium - Imperial Fists.cat offers them: Crimson Fists (CHCF) and Exorcists (CHES) under 'Successor Chapters', Executioners (CHEX, a Forge World chapter shown only for Imperial Fists).
Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Iron Hands subfaction (CHIH, parent_id SM) and Sons of Medusa (CHSO, the Forge World chapter BSData shows only for Iron Hands).
Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Raven Guard subfaction (CHRG, parent_id SM) and Raptors (CHRA, the Forge World chapter BSData shows only for Raven Guard).
Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Salamanders subfaction (CHSA, parent_id SM). BSData Imperium - Salamanders.cat names no successor chapter that Wahapedia lists.
Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Space Wolves subfaction (CHSW, parent_id SM) and Wolfspear (CHWO), the 'Wolf Spears' of BSData Imperium - Space Wolves.cat's 'Successor Chapters'.

Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), Ultramarines subfaction (CHUL, parent_id SM) and its successors as BSData Imperium - Ultramarines.cat offers them: Emperor's Spears (CHEM), Silver Templars (CHST), Tome Keepers (CHTK) and Castellans of the Rift (CHCR) under 'Successor Chapters'; Howling Griffons (CHHG), Marines Errant (CHME), Fire Angels (CHFA), Novamarines (CHNO) and Fire Hawks (CHFH), Forge World chapters shown only for Ultramarines.
Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM), White Scars subfaction (CHWS, parent_id SM) and Mantis Warriors (CHMW, the Forge World chapter BSData shows only for White Scars).

No Wahapedia faction of its own. Its Primaris Psyker and Astropath are ASTRA MILITARUM (BSData Imperium - Adeptus Astra Telepathica.cat) and sit on the Wahapedia Astra Militarum page (Factions.csv AM); no regiment subfactions.
Wahapedia Adeptus Custodes page (Factions.csv AC, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/adeptus-custodes); 'all' for its Shield Hosts (SHxx, parent_id AC).
Wahapedia Adeptus Mechanicus page (Factions.csv AdM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/adeptus-mechanicus); 'all' for its Forge Worlds (FWxx, parent_id AdM).

The Wahapedia Agents of the Imperium page's (Factions.csv AoI) eight stratagems are all Boarding Actions. Its matched-play stratagems are the Elucidian Starstriders' on the Rogue Traders page (Factions.csv RT, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/rogue-traders): BSData's Agents of the Imperium catalogue (Imperium - Inquisition.cat) imports Imperium - Imperial Navy.cat, which holds 'Dataslate: Elucidian Starstriders'.
Wahapedia Astra Militarum page (Factions.csv AM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/astra-militarum); 'all' for Militarum Tempestus and Brood Brothers (parent_id AM).

Its units sit on the Wahapedia Rogue Traders (RT) and Unaligned (UN) pages. RT's only matched-play stratagems are the Elucidian Starstriders', each naming a Starstriders model or unit that this catalogue lacks, so it maps to Unaligned (Factions.csv UN), which has no stratagems.
Wahapedia Grey Knights page (Factions.csv GK, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/grey-knights); 'all' for its Brotherhoods (BRxx, parent_id GK).
Wahapedia Imperial Knights page (Factions.csv QI, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/imperial-knights); 'all' for its households and Freeblades (parent_id QI).

Wahapedia Space Marines page (Factions.csv SM, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/space-marines) with no chapter subfaction: Legion of the Damned units have no <CHAPTER> (BSData Imperium - Legion of the Damned.cat: Adeptus Astartes, Imperium, Legion of the Damned).
Wahapedia Titan Legions page (Factions.csv TL, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/titan-legions); Stratagems.csv has no TL stratagems.
Wahapedia Leagues of Votann page (Factions.csv LoV, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/leagues-of-votann); 'all' for its Leagues (LUxx, parent_id LoV).
Wahapedia Necrons page (Factions.csv NEC, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/necrons); 'all' for its dynasties (DYxx, parent_id NEC).
Wahapedia Orks page (Factions.csv ORK, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/orks); 'all' for its clans (CLxx, parent_id ORK).
Wahapedia T’au Empire page (Factions.csv TAU, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/t-au-empire); 'all' for its septs (SExx, parent_id TAU).
Wahapedia Tyranids page (Factions.csv TYR, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/tyranids); 'all' for its hive fleets (HFxx, parent_id TYR).
Wahapedia Genestealer Cults page (Factions.csv GC, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/genestealer-cults); 'all' for its cults (CUxx, parent_id GC).
Wahapedia Unaligned page (Factions.csv UN, wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/factions/unaligned); Stratagems.csv has no UN stratagems.
